titleZh: SpaceX IPO——纳斯达克敲钟演讲
summaryEn: As SpaceX goes public, Elon Musk speaks before ringing the Nasdaq opening bell — recalling his early doubts the company would survive and restating the goal of making life multiplanetary. The largest IPO ever, valuing SpaceX near $1.77 trillion.
summaryZh: 随着SpaceX上市，埃隆·马斯克在敲响纳斯达克开市钟之前发表讲话——回忆他早期对公司能否存活的怀疑，并重申让生命成为多行星物种的目标。这是史上规模最大的IPO，SpaceX估值接近1.77万亿美元。

segments.textEn: Four or five thousand people, thank you so much.

Gave I gave SpaceX less than a 10% chance of succeeding at all, to be clear. In fact I told people this, I said, look, we're probably going to fail, but we should give it a try because if we don't, if there's not a new company that enters space, we will never be a truly space faring civilization.
segments.textZh: 我，我认为SpaceX成功的概率不到10%，说清楚一点，是任何程度上的成功。事实上，我当时告诉过人们这件事，我说，听着，我们很可能会失败，但我们应该试一试，因为如果我们不试，如果没有一家新公司进入太空，我们就永远无法成为一个真正的太空航行文明。

segments.textEn: While the other aerospace companies, they built good rockets and everything, they were simply not pursuing the technology that's necessary to make life multi planetary, To make Star Trek, to make the exciting science fiction futures that we've read about real. And that's what SpaceX is all about, is to take the fiction out of science fiction and create an exciting, inspiring Future for everyone.
segments.textZh: 至于其他航空航天公司，它们造出了很好的火箭和各种东西，但它们根本没有在追求让生命成为多行星物种所必需的技术，让《星际迷航》成真，让我们读到过的那些激动人心的科幻未来成为现实。而这正是SpaceX的一切所在：从科幻小说中拿掉虚构，给所有人创造一个激动人心、鼓舞人心的未来。

segments.textEn: SpaceX wants to be able to take you to the moon, take you to Mars and ultimately beyond.
segments.textZh: SpaceX希望能够把你送上月球，把你送往火星，并最终送往更远的地方。

segments.textEn: And I'm confident at this point that with the incredible team that we have here at SpaceX that we will do that for you.
segments.textZh: 而现在我有信心，凭借我们在SpaceX这里拥有的这支不可思议的团队，我们会为你们做到这一点。

segments.textEn: There are always problems on Earth. There are always problems on Earth. There are always things that we wish to be better, that we want to solve here on Earth and we should solve them. But there also have to be things that get you excited about the future, that make you glad to wake up in the morning because you can't wait to see what happens next. And that's the future that SpaceX wants to bring to you.
segments.textZh: 地球上总有问题。地球上总有问题。总有一些事情是我们希望变得更好的，是我们想在地球上解决的，而且我们应该解决它们。但也必须有一些事情能让你对未来感到兴奋，让你庆幸自己早晨醒来，因为你迫不及待地想看看接下来会发生什么。而这就是SpaceX想带给你们的未来。

segments.textEn: Elon founded this company in 2002 initially to build rockets and spaceships that will take humans to Mars, the moon and even beyond. We've not quite gotten to Mars. We're almost at the moon.
segments.textZh: 埃隆于2002年创办了这家公司，最初是为了建造将人类送往火星、月球，甚至更远地方的火箭和宇宙飞船。我们还没有完全抵达火星。我们快到月球了。

segments.textEn: With the merger, the acquisition of xai, we now as a group own the largest coherent gigawatt class compute on the planet, which will help us truth, seek and understand the universe. So congratulations to all of us for that. Everyone said we could never get to orbit it, check. But it was a little rocket. Then it's, everyone said, well you can't get a real.
segments.textZh: 随着合并，随着对xAI的收购，我们如今作为一个集团拥有地球上规模最大的、统一的吉瓦级算力，这将帮助我们追寻真相并理解宇宙。所以为我们所有人取得这一成就表示祝贺。所有人都说我们绝不可能进入轨道，完成。但那是一枚小火箭。然后是，所有人都说，嗯，你们造不出一枚真正的。
